summary.zh: 设计文档：公开规则的渐进式加载（标签选择、读取时切片、体积测算、兼容与迁移契约）；运行时与公开 catalog 的实现见 opinion-manager 条目。
summary.en: Design document: progressive loading of public rules (tag selection, read-time slicing, size measurements, compatibility and the migration contract); the runtime and public catalog implementation are described under the opinion-manager entries.
